title: UI feedback controls manifest
description: The one list of what can vary on a non-final page: the page's <script type="application/json" id="prototype-controls"> holds one such object (docs/contracts/ui-feedback). x-version moves on any change. Each control writes its value to its target: a target starting -- is a CSS custom property, one starting data-control- an attribute, set on the element of the variant it names, else on the page root. A range writes its value followed by its unit; a toggle writes its first option when off and its second when on; every other type writes the option or color chosen. default is the value the control starts at and Reset controls returns to. A note's controls (snapshot) maps each control id to its value when the note was taken. Every string here is written by the model, and the host page treats it as data: labels and options reach the screen as text only.
